item.title: PaaS Deployment with Buildpack
item.description: I have been learning Go recently, and the internal PaaS platform we commonly use happens to support Go as well as related Web frameworks. A PaaS system that supports multiple languages cannot do without the buildpack mechanism. Although PaaS platforms keep being upgraded, the buildpack mechanism has always been retained.
